id-20261107-news-1.title: Harbolnas 11.11 2026: How to Read Discounts, Avoid Fake Prices, and Know Your Consumer Rights

segments.src: Festival belanja 11.11 tinggal hitungan hari.
segments.tr: The 11.11 shopping festival is just days away.

segments.src: Seperti tahun-tahun sebelumnya, platform belanja daring, merek, dan penjual menyiapkan beragam promo: flash sale, voucher, gratis ongkos kirim, hingga potongan harga berlapis.
segments.tr: Like in previous years, online shopping platforms, brands, and sellers are preparing various promotions: flash sales, vouchers, free shipping, and tiered discounts.

segments.src: Bagi konsumen, momen ini memang bisa menghemat pengeluaran.
segments.tr: For consumers, this moment can indeed save expenses.

segments.src: Namun angka diskon yang besar di layar tidak selalu berarti harga yang benar-benar murah.
segments.tr: However, a large discount number on the screen does not always mean the price is truly cheap.

segments.src: Artikel ini membahas cara membaca diskon dengan teliti, mengenali penawaran yang menyesatkan, serta memahami hak konsumen terkait pengembalian barang dan penyelesaian sengketa transaksi.
segments.tr: This article discusses how to read discounts carefully, recognize misleading offers, and understand consumer rights regarding product returns and transaction dispute resolution.

segments.src: Isinya bersifat informasi umum, bukan nasihat hukum.
segments.tr: The content is for general information, not legal advice.

segments.src: ## Mengapa harga coret perlu dicek
segments.tr: ## Why crossed-out prices need to be checked

segments.src: Harga coret adalah harga yang dicantumkan di samping harga promo untuk menunjukkan seberapa besar potongannya.
segments.tr: A crossed-out price is the price listed next to the promotional price to show how big the discount is.

segments.src: Masalahnya, harga coret tidak selalu mencerminkan harga yang pernah berlaku.
segments.tr: The problem is, the crossed-out price does not always reflect a price that was actually in effect.

segments.src: Ada beberapa pola yang sering dijumpai:
segments.tr: There are several patterns often encountered:

segments.src: - **Harga awal dinaikkan sebelum promo.** Harga barang naik beberapa hari sebelum festival, lalu "diturunkan" kembali saat promo sehingga persentase diskon tampak besar.
segments.tr: - **Initial price raised before the promo.** The item price goes up a few days before the festival, then is "lowered" back down during the promo so the discount percentage looks large.

segments.src: - **Harga coret terlalu tinggi.** Angka yang dicoret jauh di atas harga pasar yang wajar, sehingga potongan 70 persen sebenarnya hanya setara harga normal di toko lain.
segments.tr: - **Crossed-out price is too high.** The crossed-out figure is far above the fair market price, so a 70 percent discount is actually just equivalent to the normal price at other stores.

segments.src: - **Diskon berlapis yang membingungkan.** Potongan toko, voucher platform, dan promo metode pembayaran digabung dalam satu angka, padahal syaratnya berbeda-beda.
segments.tr: - **Confusing tiered discounts.** Store discounts, platform vouchers, and payment method promos are combined into one figure, even though the terms are different.

segments.src: ## Langkah praktis membandingkan harga asli
segments.tr: ## Practical steps to compare the real price

segments.src: 1. **Catat harga sejak sekarang.** Jika sudah ada barang incaran, simpan tangkapan layar harganya beberapa hari sebelum 11.11. Ini menjadi pembanding yang paling jujur.
segments.tr: 1. **Record prices from now on.** If you already have an item in mind, save a screenshot of the price a few days before 11.11. This becomes the most honest comparison.

segments.src: 2. **Bandingkan lintas toko dan platform.** Cari produk yang sama (model, ukuran, dan varian yang sama) di toko resmi merek, marketplace lain, dan toko fisik.
segments.tr: 2. **Compare across stores and platforms.** Look for the same product (same model, size, and variant) at official brand stores, other marketplaces, and physical stores.

segments.src: 3. **Periksa riwayat harga bila tersedia.** Sebagian platform atau alat pembanding harga menampilkan grafik perubahan harga. Gunakan sebagai petunjuk, bukan satu-satunya acuan.
segments.tr: 3. **Check price history if available.** Some platforms or price comparison tools display price change charts. Use them as a guide, not the only reference.

segments.src: 4. **Hitung harga akhir, bukan persentase.** Jumlahkan harga barang, ongkos kirim, biaya layanan, dan biaya admin. Diskon 50 persen dengan ongkos kirim mahal bisa lebih mahal daripada diskon 30 persen dengan ongkos kirim gratis.
segments.tr: 4. **Calculate the final price, not the percentage.** Add up the item price, shipping costs, service fees, and admin fees. A 50 percent discount with expensive shipping can be more expensive than a 30 percent discount with free shipping.

segments.src: 5. **Perhatikan batas voucher.** Cermati minimal belanja, potongan maksimal, kuota, periode berlaku, dan metode pembayaran yang disyaratkan.
segments.tr: 5. **Pay attention to voucher limits.** Examine the minimum spend, maximum discount, quota, validity period, and required payment method.

segments.src: 6. **Pastikan spesifikasi sama.** Harga murah kadang berlaku untuk varian yang lebih rendah, kapasitas lebih kecil, atau paket tanpa aksesori.
segments.tr: 6. **Ensure the specifications are the same.** Cheap prices sometimes apply to lower variants, smaller capacities, or packages without accessories.

segments.src: ## Tanda-tanda penawaran yang menyesatkan
segments.tr: ## Signs of misleading offers

segments.src: Waspadai beberapa ciri berikut sebelum menekan tombol bayar:
segments.tr: Be wary of the following signs before pressing the pay button:

segments.src: - **Tekanan waktu berlebihan.** Penghitung waktu mundur dan pesan "tinggal 2 buah" dapat membuat konsumen terburu-buru. Jika penawaran memang bagus, beberapa menit untuk memeriksa tidak akan merugikan.
segments.tr: - **Excessive time pressure.** Countdown timers and messages like "only 2 left" can make consumers rush. If the offer is truly good, a few minutes to check will not hurt.

segments.src: - **Harga jauh di bawah pasar tanpa penjelasan.** Barang elektronik atau kosmetik bermerek yang dijual separuh harga dari toko resmi layak dicurigai sebagai barang palsu, bekas, atau penipuan.
segments.tr: - **Price far below market without explanation.** Branded electronics or cosmetics sold at half the price of official stores are worth suspecting as fake, used, or a scam.

segments.src: - **Syarat dan ketentuan sulit dibaca.** Catatan kecil seperti "S&K berlaku" sering memuat pembatasan penting.
segments.tr: - **Terms and conditions are hard to read.** Small print like "T&Cs apply" often contains important restrictions.

segments.src: - **Ulasan tidak wajar.** Ulasan yang seragam, terlalu singkat, atau muncul dalam jumlah besar dalam waktu bersamaan perlu dibaca dengan hati-hati. Lihat juga ulasan yang menyertakan foto dan yang bernada kritis.
segments.tr: - **Unnatural reviews.** Reviews that are uniform, too short, or appear in large numbers at the same time need to be read carefully. Also look at reviews that include photos and those that are critical.

segments.src: - **Ajakan pindah ke luar aplikasi.** Penjual yang meminta pembayaran lewat transfer langsung atau obrolan pribadi membuat konsumen kehilangan perlindungan sistem rekening bersama atau dana tertahan milik platform.
segments.tr: - **Requests to move outside the application.** Sellers who ask for payment via direct transfer or private chat make consumers lose the protection of the escrow system or the platform's held funds.

segments.src: - **Tautan dan pesan mencurigakan.** Menjelang festival belanja, pesan berisi tautan "promo eksklusif" atau "hadiah undian" kerap dipakai untuk pencurian data. Buka promo hanya lewat aplikasi atau situs resmi, dan jangan pernah membagikan kode OTP, PIN, atau kata sandi.
segments.tr: - **Suspicious links and messages.** Approaching the shopping festival, messages containing "exclusive promo" or "prize draw" links are often used for data theft. Open promos only via the official application or site, and never share OTP codes, PINs, or passwords.

segments.src: ## Kebiasaan aman saat bertransaksi
segments.tr: ## Safe habits when transacting

segments.src: - Prioritaskan toko resmi atau penjual dengan reputasi yang bisa ditelusuri.
segments.tr: - Prioritize official stores or sellers with a traceable reputation.

segments.src: - Gunakan metode pembayaran yang disediakan platform dan simpan bukti transaksi, nomor pesanan, serta tangkapan layar halaman produk.
segments.tr: - Use the payment methods provided by the platform and save transaction proof, order numbers, and screenshots of the product page.

segments.src: - Rekam video saat membuka paket (unboxing), terutama untuk barang elektronik atau barang mudah pecah. Rekaman ini sangat membantu bila barang rusak atau tidak sesuai.
segments.tr: - Record a video when opening the package (unboxing), especially for electronics or fragile items. This recording is very helpful if the item is damaged or incorrect.

segments.src: - Konfirmasi penerimaan barang di aplikasi hanya setelah Anda memeriksa isi paket, karena konfirmasi biasanya melepaskan dana ke penjual.
segments.tr: - Confirm receipt of the item in the application only after you have checked the contents of the package, because confirmation usually releases funds to the seller.

segments.src: - Hindari menyimpan data kartu di banyak platform dan aktifkan verifikasi dua langkah.
segments.tr: - Avoid saving card data on many platforms and enable two-step verification.

segments.src: - Tetapkan anggaran sebelum berbelanja agar tidak tergoda membeli barang yang sebenarnya tidak dibutuhkan.
segments.tr: - Set a budget before shopping so you are not tempted to buy items you don't actually need.

segments.src: ## Hak konsumen yang perlu diketahui
segments.tr: ## Consumer rights you need to know

segments.src: Di Indonesia, perlindungan konsumen diatur antara lain dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 8 Tahun 1999 tentang Perlindungan Konsumen.
segments.tr: In Indonesia, consumer protection is regulated, among others, in Law Number 8 of 1999 concerning Consumer Protection.

segments.src: Secara garis besar, konsumen berhak atas:
segments.tr: Broadly speaking, consumers are entitled to:

segments.src: - **Informasi yang benar, jelas, dan jujur** tentang kondisi dan jaminan barang atau jasa.
segments.tr: - **Correct, clear, and honest information** about the condition and guarantee of goods or services.

segments.src: - **Kenyamanan, keamanan, dan keselamatan** dalam menggunakan barang atau jasa.
segments.tr: - **Comfort, security, and safety** in using goods or services.

segments.src: - **Kompensasi, ganti rugi, atau penggantian** apabila barang yang diterima tidak sesuai dengan perjanjian atau tidak sebagaimana mestinya.
segments.tr: - **Compensation, damages, or replacement** if the goods received are not in accordance with the agreement or not as they should be.

segments.src: - **Advokasi dan penyelesaian sengketa** secara patut.
segments.tr: - **Advocacy and dispute resolution** properly.

segments.src: - **Diperlakukan secara benar dan jujur**, serta tidak diskriminatif.
segments.tr: - **Being treated correctly and honestly**, and not being discriminated against.

segments.src: Undang-undang tersebut juga melarang pelaku usaha menawarkan barang dengan cara yang menyesatkan, termasuk memberikan keterangan yang tidak benar mengenai harga atau potongan harga.
segments.tr: The law also prohibits business actors from offering goods in a misleading way, including providing incorrect information regarding prices or discounts.

segments.src: Selain itu, transaksi perdagangan melalui sistem elektronik memiliki aturan tersendiri, misalnya dalam Peraturan Pemerintah tentang Perdagangan Melalui Sistem Elektronik, yang antara lain mewajibkan pelaku usaha menyampaikan informasi yang lengkap dan benar.
segments.tr: In addition, electronic trading transactions have their own rules, for example in the Government Regulation on Trading Through Electronic Systems, which among other things requires business actors to provide complete and correct information.

segments.src: ## Soal pengembalian barang
segments.tr: ## Regarding product returns

segments.src: Kebijakan pengembalian berbeda-beda antarplatform dan antarpenjual, sehingga bacalah sebelum membeli.
segments.tr: Return policies differ between platforms and between sellers, so read them before buying.

segments.src: Hal yang biasanya perlu diperhatikan:
segments.tr: Things that usually need attention:

segments.src: - **Batas waktu pengajuan.** Umumnya terbatas beberapa hari sejak barang diterima atau sejak pesanan dinyatakan selesai.
segments.tr: - **Submission time limit.** Generally limited to a few days from when the item is received or from when the order is declared complete.

segments.src: - **Alasan yang diterima.** Barang rusak, salah kirim, cacat, atau tidak sesuai deskripsi biasanya dapat diajukan. Alasan "berubah pikiran" tidak selalu diterima.
segments.tr: - **Accepted reasons.** Damaged, wrongly sent, defective, or not as described items can usually be submitted. "Changed mind" reasons are not always accepted.

segments.src: - **Syarat kondisi barang.** Banyak kebijakan mensyaratkan kemasan asli, segel, label, dan kelengkapan aksesori.
segments.tr: - **Item condition requirements.** Many policies require original packaging, seals, labels, and complete accessories.

segments.src: - **Barang yang dikecualikan.** Produk tertentu, seperti barang yang mudah rusak, produk perawatan pribadi yang telah dibuka, atau voucher digital, sering tidak dapat dikembalikan.
segments.tr: - **Excluded items.** Certain products, such as perishable goods, opened personal care products, or digital vouchers, often cannot be returned.

segments.src: - **Bukti.** Foto, video unboxing, dan riwayat percakapan di aplikasi memperkuat pengajuan.
segments.tr: - **Proof.** Photos, unboxing videos, and chat history in the application strengthen the submission.

segments.src: Karena promo besar kerap menarik pembeli baru, periksa juga ketentuan garansi resmi dan layanan purna jual sebelum membeli, terutama untuk barang elektronik.
segments.tr: Because big promos often attract new buyers, also check the official warranty terms and after-sales service before buying, especially for electronics.

segments.src: ## Jika terjadi sengketa transaksi
segments.tr: ## If a transaction dispute occurs

segments.src: Bila terjadi masalah, tempuh langkah bertahap:
segments.tr: If a problem occurs, take gradual steps:

segments.src: 1. **Hubungi penjual lebih dulu** lewat fitur obrolan resmi, jelaskan masalahnya dengan tenang, dan lampirkan bukti.
segments.tr: 1. **Contact the seller first** via the official chat feature, explain the problem calmly, and attach proof.

segments.src: 2. **Ajukan komplain atau pengembalian lewat platform** sebelum batas waktunya habis, dan jangan mengonfirmasi penerimaan jika masalah belum selesai.
segments.tr: 2. **File a complaint or return via the platform** before the deadline expires, and do not confirm receipt if the problem is not yet resolved.

segments.src: 3. **Eskalasi ke layanan pelanggan platform** bila penjual tidak menanggapi. Banyak platform memiliki mekanisme penengahan.
segments.tr: 3. **Escalate to the platform's customer service** if the seller does not respond. Many platforms have mediation mechanisms.

segments.src: 4. **Hubungi penyedia metode pembayaran** (bank, dompet digital, atau penyedia kartu) bila ada transaksi yang tidak Anda kenali atau dugaan penipuan.
segments.tr: 4. **Contact the payment method provider** (bank, digital wallet, or card provider) if there is a transaction you do not recognize or suspected fraud.

segments.src: 5. **Manfaatkan lembaga penyelesaian sengketa konsumen.** Konsumen dapat mengadu ke Badan Penyelesaian Sengketa Konsumen (BPSK), lembaga perlindungan konsumen swasta, atau layanan pengaduan konsumen milik pemerintah. Untuk dugaan penipuan, konsumen juga dapat melapor kepada pihak kepolisian.
segments.tr: 5. **Utilize consumer dispute resolution bodies.** Consumers can complain to the Consumer Dispute Resolution Agency (BPSK), private consumer protection agencies, or government-owned consumer complaint services. For suspected fraud, consumers can also report to the police.

segments.src: Simpan semua bukti dengan rapi: tangkapan layar halaman produk dan harga, bukti pembayaran, percakapan, nomor resi, serta foto atau video kondisi barang.
segments.tr: Keep all evidence neatly: screenshots of product pages and prices, proof of payment, conversations, receipt numbers, and photos or videos of the item's condition.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan: daftar periksa sebelum membayar
segments.tr: ## Summary: checklist before paying

segments.src: - Sudahkah saya membandingkan harga dengan toko lain dan riwayat harga sebelumnya?
segments.tr: - Have I compared prices with other stores and previous price history?

segments.src: - Apakah harga akhir, termasuk ongkos kirim dan biaya layanan, benar-benar lebih murah?
segments.tr: - Is the final price, including shipping and service fees, really cheaper?

segments.src: - Apakah varian dan spesifikasi produk sama dengan yang saya cari?
segments.tr: - Are the product variants and specifications the same as what I am looking for?

segments.src: - Apakah penjual terpercaya dan transaksi dilakukan di dalam platform?
segments.tr: - Is the seller trusted and is the transaction done within the platform?

segments.src: - Sudahkah saya membaca kebijakan pengembalian dan garansi?
segments.tr: - Have I read the return and warranty policy?

segments.src: - Apakah barang ini memang saya butuhkan dan sesuai anggaran?
segments.tr: - Do I really need this item and is it within budget?

segments.src: Festival belanja bisa menjadi kesempatan berhemat bagi konsumen yang teliti.
segments.tr: Shopping festivals can be a saving opportunity for careful consumers.

segments.src: Kuncinya sederhana: jangan terpaku pada angka persentase, periksa harga akhir, pahami syarat, dan kenali hak Anda.
segments.tr: The key is simple: don't get hung up on percentage numbers, check the final price, understand the terms, and know your rights.

segments.src: Dengan begitu, belanja 11.11 tetap menyenangkan dan aman.
segments.tr: That way, 11.11 shopping remains fun and safe.

segments.src: *Catatan: Informasi dalam artikel ini bersifat umum dan dapat berubah.
segments.tr: *Note: The information in this article is general and subject to change.

segments.src: Periksa ketentuan terbaru pada platform yang Anda gunakan serta sumber resmi pemerintah atau lembaga perlindungan konsumen.*
segments.tr: Check the latest terms on the platform you use as well as official government sources or consumer protection agencies.*

id-20261107-news-3.title: Gaza, Ukraine, and the South China Sea: How to Read Geopolitical Tensions, Their Impact on Energy Prices, and Indonesia's Diplomacy

segments.src: Berita tentang konflik di Timur Tengah, Eropa Timur, dan Asia Timur hampir setiap hari mengisi layar ponsel kita.
segments.tr: News about conflicts in the Middle East, Eastern Europe, and East Asia fills our phone screens almost every day.

segments.src: Sebagian pembaca merasa isu-isu itu jauh dari kehidupan sehari-hari.
segments.tr: Some readers feel these issues are far removed from their daily lives.

segments.src: Padahal, ketegangan di kawasan-kawasan tersebut dapat memengaruhi harga bahan bakar, ongkos pengiriman barang, nilai tukar, hingga arah kebijakan luar negeri Indonesia.
segments.tr: In fact, tensions in these regions can affect fuel prices, shipping costs for goods, exchange rates, and even the direction of Indonesia's foreign policy.

segments.src: Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan edukatif: bukan untuk memihak, melainkan membantu Anda membaca situasi dengan lebih tenang dan kritis.
segments.tr: This article is informative and educational: not to take sides, but to help you read the situation more calmly and critically.

segments.src: ## Tiga kawasan, tiga jenis risiko
segments.tr: ## Three regions, three types of risks

segments.src: Ketiga isu ini berbeda sifatnya, sehingga dampak ekonominya pun berbeda.
segments.tr: These three issues are different in nature, so their economic impacts are also different.

segments.src: - **Gaza dan Timur Tengah.** Kawasan ini berdekatan dengan jalur pasokan minyak dan gas dunia serta rute pelayaran penting seperti Terusan Suez dan Laut Merah. Kekhawatiran pasar biasanya muncul ketika konflik dinilai berpotensi meluas dan mengganggu pasokan atau pelayaran.
segments.tr: - **Gaza and the Middle East.** This region is close to global oil and gas supply lines and important shipping routes such as the Suez Canal and the Red Sea. Market concerns usually arise when a conflict is perceived as having the potential to expand and disrupt supply or shipping.

segments.src: - **Ukraina dan Eropa Timur.** Rusia adalah produsen energi dan komoditas pertanian yang besar, sedangkan Ukraina dikenal sebagai pemasok gandum dan minyak nabati. Gangguan di kawasan ini memengaruhi harga gas, energi, dan pangan, terutama di Eropa, tetapi efeknya merambat ke pasar global.
segments.tr: - **Ukraine and Eastern Europe.** Russia is a major producer of energy and agricultural commodities, while Ukraine is known as a supplier of wheat and vegetable oil. Disruptions in this region affect gas, energy, and food prices, especially in Europe, but the effects ripple out to the global market.

segments.src: - **Laut Cina Selatan.** Kawasan ini adalah salah satu jalur perdagangan tersibuk di dunia. Sengketa wilayah di sini jarang langsung menaikkan harga minyak, tetapi risiko terhadap pelayaran dan rantai pasok membuat pelaku usaha terus memantaunya. Sebagian perairan Natuna Utara yang berada dalam zona ekonomi eksklusif Indonesia juga berkaitan langsung dengan kepentingan nasional kita.
segments.tr: - **South China Sea.** This region is one of the busiest trade routes in the world. Territorial disputes here rarely directly raise oil prices, but risks to shipping and supply chains keep business players monitoring it closely. Parts of the North Natuna waters that are within Indonesia's exclusive economic zone are also directly related to our national interests.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana ketegangan memengaruhi harga energi
segments.tr: ## How tensions affect energy prices

segments.src: Harga minyak tidak hanya dipengaruhi pasokan dan permintaan fisik.
segments.tr: Oil prices are not only influenced by physical supply and demand.

segments.src: Ada beberapa saluran yang perlu dipahami:
segments.tr: There are several channels to understand:

segments.src: 1. **Risiko pasokan.** Pasar sering bereaksi terhadap *kemungkinan* gangguan, bukan hanya gangguan yang sudah terjadi. Itu sebabnya harga bisa naik cepat saat berita memanas, lalu turun lagi ketika kekhawatiran mereda.
segments.tr: 1. **Supply risk.** Markets often react to the *possibility* of disruption, not just disruptions that have already occurred. That is why prices can rise quickly when news heats up, then fall again when concerns subside.

segments.src: 2. **Jalur pelayaran dan asuransi.** Jika kapal harus memutar rute atau premi asuransi naik, biaya angkut meningkat dan akhirnya ikut menekan harga barang.
segments.tr: 2. **Shipping routes and insurance.** If ships have to reroute or insurance premiums rise, transport costs increase and eventually put pressure on the prices of goods.

segments.src: 3. **Sentimen dan nilai tukar.** Ketidakpastian global kerap mendorong investor beralih ke aset yang dianggap aman, sehingga mata uang negara berkembang, termasuk rupiah, dapat tertekan.
segments.tr: 3. **Sentiment and exchange rates.** Global uncertainty often drives investors to switch to assets considered safe, so the currencies of developing countries, including the rupiah, can come under pressure.

segments.src: 4. **Keputusan produsen.** Kebijakan produksi negara-negara penghasil minyak, kondisi ekonomi global, dan tingkat persediaan juga ikut menentukan harga, sering kali lebih besar daripada satu peristiwa geopolitik.
segments.tr: 4. **Producer decisions.** The production policies of oil-producing countries, global economic conditions, and inventory levels also determine prices, often more so than a single geopolitical event.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, harga minyak dunia memengaruhi anggaran subsidi dan kompensasi energi, harga bahan bakar nonsubsidi, serta biaya logistik.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, world oil prices affect the energy subsidy and compensation budget, non-subsidized fuel prices, and logistics costs.

segments.src: Namun besar dampaknya bergantung pada kebijakan pemerintah, nilai tukar, dan kondisi ekonomi domestik pada saat itu.
segments.tr: However, the magnitude of the impact depends on government policy, exchange rates, and domestic economic conditions at the time.

segments.src: Karena itu, hindari kesimpulan sederhana seperti "satu konflik pasti membuat harga naik sekian persen".
segments.tr: Therefore, avoid simple conclusions such as "one conflict will definitely make prices rise by X percent".

segments.src: ## Memilah sumber berita yang kredibel
segments.tr: ## Sorting out credible news sources

segments.src: Dalam situasi konflik, informasi menyebar cepat, termasuk kabar yang keliru.
segments.tr: In a conflict situation, information spreads quickly, including false news.

segments.src: Beberapa kebiasaan berikut dapat membantu:
segments.tr: The following habits can help:

segments.src: - **Periksa sumber asli.** Cari tahu apakah berita berasal dari kantor berita atau media yang memiliki redaksi, kebijakan koreksi, dan reputasi yang jelas.
segments.tr: - **Check the original source.** Find out if the news comes from a news agency or media outlet that has an editorial board, correction policy, and a clear reputation.

segments.src: - **Bandingkan beberapa sumber.** Baca minimal dua atau tiga media dengan sudut pandang berbeda, termasuk kantor berita internasional dan media nasional.
segments.tr: - **Compare multiple sources.** Read at least two or three media outlets with different perspectives, including international news agencies and national media.

segments.src: - **Bedakan fakta, klaim, dan opini.** Pernyataan pihak yang berkonflik adalah klaim, bukan otomatis fakta. Perhatikan frasa seperti "menurut pejabat" atau "belum dapat diverifikasi secara independen".
segments.tr: - **Distinguish between facts, claims, and opinions.** Statements from conflicting parties are claims, not automatically facts. Pay attention to phrases like "according to officials" or "cannot be independently verified yet".

segments.src: - **Waspadai judul sensasional.** Kata-kata seperti "meledak", "tamat", atau "dunia di ambang perang" sering dipakai untuk menarik klik, bukan untuk menggambarkan keadaan.
segments.tr: - **Beware of sensational headlines.** Words like "explode", "finished", or "world on the brink of war" are often used to attract clicks, not to describe the situation.

segments.src: - **Cek foto dan video.** Gambar lama sering dipakai ulang dengan keterangan baru. Gunakan pencarian gambar terbalik dan lihat apakah lembaga pemeriksa fakta sudah membahasnya.
segments.tr: - **Check photos and videos.** Old images are often reused with new captions. Use reverse image search and see if fact-checking organizations have already discussed them.

segments.src: - **Rujuk data resmi.** Untuk harga energi dan ekonomi, lihat publikasi lembaga resmi seperti Kementerian ESDM, Bank Indonesia, Badan Pusat Statistik, serta lembaga internasional seperti Badan Energi Internasional (IEA) atau Bank Dunia.
segments.tr: - **Refer to official data.** For energy and economic prices, look at publications from official institutions such as the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, Bank Indonesia, the Central Statistics Agency, and international institutions such as the International Energy Agency (IEA) or the World Bank.

segments.src: - **Pikirkan sebelum membagikan.** Jika belum yakin akurat, sebaiknya jangan disebarkan.
segments.tr: - **Think before sharing.** If you are not sure it is accurate, it is better not to spread it.

segments.src: ## Politik luar negeri bebas-aktif di tengah dinamika global
segments.tr: ## Independent and active foreign policy amidst global dynamics

segments.src: Prinsip bebas-aktif berarti Indonesia tidak berpihak pada blok kekuatan mana pun (bebas), tetapi tetap berperan aktif dalam menjaga perdamaian dunia dan kerja sama internasional (aktif).
segments.tr: The independent and active principle means that Indonesia does not side with any power bloc (independent), but remains active in maintaining world peace and international cooperation (active).

segments.src: Prinsip ini bersumber dari Pembukaan UUD 1945 dan telah menjadi pedoman sejak awal kemerdekaan.
segments.tr: This principle stems from the Preamble of the 1945 Constitution and has been a guideline since the beginning of independence.

segments.src: Dalam praktiknya, posisi ini terlihat pada beberapa hal:
segments.tr: In practice, this position is seen in several things:

segments.src: - **Mengedepankan hukum internasional dan Piagam PBB**, termasuk penghormatan terhadap kedaulatan dan integritas wilayah negara.
segments.tr: - **Prioritizing international law and the UN Charter**, including respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity of nations.

segments.src: - **Dukungan bagi penyelesaian damai dan bantuan kemanusiaan**, serta dukungan lama Indonesia bagi kemerdekaan Palestina melalui solusi dua negara.
segments.tr: - **Support for peaceful resolution and humanitarian aid**, as well as Indonesia's long-standing support for Palestinian independence through a two-state solution.

segments.src: - **Menjaga hubungan baik dengan banyak mitra**, baik di Barat maupun Timur, demi kepentingan ekonomi dan keamanan nasional.
segments.tr: - **Maintaining good relations with many partners**, both in the West and the East, for the sake of national economic and security interests.

segments.src: - **Peran di ASEAN.** Di Laut Cina Selatan, Indonesia mendorong penyelesaian sengketa secara damai dan perundingan kode etik (Code of Conduct) antara ASEAN dan Tiongkok, sambil tetap menegaskan hak berdaulat di perairan Natuna Utara berdasarkan UNCLOS 1982.
segments.tr: - **Role in ASEAN.** In the South China Sea, Indonesia encourages peaceful dispute resolution and negotiations for a Code of Conduct between ASEAN and China, while continuing to assert sovereign rights in the North Natuna waters based on UNCLOS 1982.

segments.src: - **Forum multilateral.** Keanggotaan dalam G20, ASEAN, dan berbagai forum lain memberi ruang bagi Indonesia untuk menyuarakan kepentingan negara berkembang.
segments.tr: - **Multilateral forums.** Membership in the G20, ASEAN, and various other forums provides space for Indonesia to voice the interests of developing countries.

segments.src: Tentu ada perdebatan tentang seberapa tegas atau seberapa seimbang kebijakan tersebut dalam situasi tertentu.
segments.tr: Of course, there is debate about how firm or how balanced the policy is in certain situations.

segments.src: Perbedaan penilaian itu wajar dalam masyarakat demokratis, dan pembaca perlu melihat argumen dari berbagai pihak.
segments.tr: Differences in assessment are natural in a democratic society, and readers need to look at arguments from various parties.

segments.src: ## Apa artinya bagi masyarakat dan pelaku usaha
segments.tr: ## What it means for society and business players

segments.src: - **Rumah tangga.** Fluktuasi harga energi bisa memengaruhi biaya transportasi dan harga barang. Perencanaan anggaran yang fleksibel membantu menghadapi perubahan.
segments.tr: - **Households.** Energy price fluctuations can affect transportation costs and the price of goods. Flexible budget planning helps in dealing with changes.

segments.src: - **Pelaku usaha.** Perusahaan yang bergantung pada impor, ekspor, atau logistik perlu memantau biaya pengiriman dan nilai tukar, serta menyiapkan alternatif pemasok.
segments.tr: - **Business players.** Companies that rely on imports, exports, or logistics need to monitor shipping costs and exchange rates, and prepare alternative suppliers.

segments.src: - **Investor.** Volatilitas jangka pendek akibat berita geopolitik sering kali tidak mencerminkan kondisi jangka panjang. Keputusan keuangan sebaiknya didasarkan pada tujuan pribadi, bukan reaksi terhadap judul berita. Artikel ini bukan nasihat investasi.
segments.tr: - **Investors.** Short-term volatility due to geopolitical news often does not reflect long-term conditions. Financial decisions should be based on personal goals, not reactions to news headlines. This article is not investment advice.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Memahami geopolitik tidak menuntut kita menjadi ahli.
segments.tr: Understanding geopolitics does not require us to be experts.

segments.src: Yang dibutuhkan adalah kebiasaan sederhana: membaca dari sumber tepercaya, membedakan fakta dari klaim, dan melihat hubungan antara peristiwa global dengan kehidupan sehari-hari.
segments.tr: What is needed is a simple habit: reading from trusted sources, distinguishing facts from claims, and seeing the connection between global events and daily life.

segments.src: Dengan begitu, kita dapat menyikapi kabar dunia secara proporsional, tidak panik dan tidak abai.
segments.tr: By doing so, we can respond to world news proportionally, without panic and without neglect.

segments.src: *Catatan: Informasi dalam artikel ini bersifat umum dan dapat berubah seiring perkembangan situasi.
segments.tr: *Note: The information in this article is general and may change as the situation develops.

segments.src: Untuk data terbaru, rujuklah sumber resmi dan media tepercaya.*
segments.tr: For the latest data, refer to official sources and trusted media.*

id-20261107-international-logistics-tran.title: [International Logistics and Transportation #15] Containers Can "Talk", Ships Must Be Carbon-Efficient: The New Face of Global Logistics

segments.src: > Logistik internasional kini dikejar dua tuntutan sekaligus: makin **digital** (barang bisa dilacak dan dokumen bisa diurus tanpa kertas) dan makin **hijau** (emisi kapal diatur ketat oleh IMO dan berbagai negara).
segments.tr: > International logistics now faces two demands at once: it is becoming more **digital** (goods can be tracked and documents handled without paper) and more **green** (ship emissions are strictly regulated by the IMO and various countries).

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Bayangkan rantai pasok global sebagai estafet raksasa: pabrik → truk → pelabuhan → kapal → pelabuhan tujuan → gudang → pembeli.
segments.tr: Think of the global supply chain as a giant relay race: factory → truck → port → ship → destination port → warehouse → buyer.

segments.src: Di kuliah-kuliah sebelumnya, kita sudah membahas pelari-pelarinya.
segments.tr: In previous lectures, we covered the runners.

segments.src: Hari ini kita membahas dua hal yang mengubah cara estafet itu dijalankan.
segments.tr: Today we cover two developments that change how that relay is run.

segments.src: Logistik pintar (smart/digital logistics)**
segments.tr: Smart/digital logistics**

segments.src: Intinya: informasi bergerak lebih cepat daripada barangnya.
segments.tr: The core idea: information moves faster than the goods.

segments.src: Beberapa wujudnya:
segments.tr: Some forms this takes:

segments.src: - **Pelacakan real-time** – sensor IoT dan GPS pada kontainer mengirim data lokasi, suhu, bahkan guncangan. Ini penting untuk kontainer berpendingin (*reefer*) yang membawa buah atau obat.
segments.tr: - **Real-time tracking** – IoT sensors and GPS on containers send location, temperature, and even shock data. This matters for refrigerated containers (*reefers*) carrying fruit or medicine.

segments.src: - **Dokumen elektronik** – misalnya *electronic Bill of Lading* (eB/L) dan sistem *single window* bea cukai. Dengan begitu, satu dokumen tidak perlu dikirim lewat kurir berhari-hari.
segments.tr: - **Electronic documents** – for example, the *electronic Bill of Lading* (eB/L) and customs *single window* systems. This way, a document does not have to be sent by courier for days.

segments.src: - **Analitik dan otomasi** – data dipakai untuk memprediksi kepadatan pelabuhan, memilih rute, dan mengatur gudang otomatis.
segments.tr: - **Analytics and automation** – data is used to predict port congestion, choose routes, and run automated warehouses.

segments.src: Manfaatnya: barang lebih jarang tertahan, biaya *demurrage* (denda kontainer yang terlalu lama di pelabuhan) bisa ditekan, dan semua pihak melihat data yang sama.
segments.tr: The benefits: goods are held up less often, *demurrage* charges (fees for containers staying too long at port) can be reduced, and all parties see the same data.

segments.src: Logistik hijau dan aturan IMO**
segments.tr: Green logistics and IMO rules

segments.src: Pelayaran mengangkut sebagian besar volume perdagangan dunia dan menyumbang sekitar 3% emisi gas rumah kaca global.
segments.tr: Shipping carries most of world trade by volume and accounts for roughly 3% of global greenhouse gas emissions.

segments.src: Karena itu, **IMO** (International Maritime Organization), badan PBB yang mengatur pelayaran, menyusun aturan secara bertahap:
segments.tr: For this reason, the **IMO** (International Maritime Organization), a UN agency that regulates shipping, has set rules in stages:

segments.src: - **2020:** batas kandungan sulfur bahan bakar kapal turun menjadi 0,50% (dari sebelumnya 3,50%).
segments.tr: - **2020:** the sulfur content limit for ship fuel dropped to 0.50% (from 3.50% previously).

segments.src: - **2023:** mulai berlaku **EEXI** (standar efisiensi desain kapal yang sudah ada) dan **CII** (peringkat karbon operasional tahunan A–E). Kapal yang terus mendapat nilai buruk wajib menyusun rencana perbaikan.
segments.tr: - **2023:** **EEXI** (an energy efficiency design standard for existing ships) and **CII** (an annual operational carbon rating from A to E) took effect. Ships that keep receiving poor ratings must prepare an improvement plan.

segments.src: - **Strategi GRK IMO 2023:** target *net-zero* emisi pelayaran internasional pada atau sekitar tahun 2050, dengan titik pemeriksaan pengurangan minimal 20% (berupaya 30%) pada 2030 dan minimal 70% (berupaya 80%) pada 2040, dibandingkan level 2008.
segments.tr: - **IMO GHG Strategy 2023:** a target of net-zero emissions from international shipping by or around 2050, with checkpoints of at least a 20% reduction (aiming for 30%) by 2030 and at least 70% (aiming for 80%) by 2040, compared with 2008 levels.

segments.src: - Mekanisme global berupa standar bahan bakar dan harga karbon (*IMO Net-Zero Framework*) sudah disetujui dalam bentuk rancangan pada 2025, tetapi proses pengesahannya ditunda dan masih dirundingkan.
segments.tr: - A global mechanism of fuel standards and carbon pricing (the *IMO Net-Zero Framework*) was agreed in draft form in 2025, but its adoption has been postponed and is still under negotiation.

segments.src: Di luar IMO, **Uni Eropa** sudah memasukkan pelayaran ke sistem perdagangan emisinya (**EU ETS**) sejak 2024.
segments.tr: Beyond the IMO, the **European Union** has included shipping in its emissions trading system (**EU ETS**) since 2024.

segments.src: Pemberlakuannya bertahap hingga mencakup penuh mulai 2026.
segments.tr: Its rollout is phased, reaching full coverage from 2026.

segments.src: Bagaimana kapal menurunkan emisi?
segments.tr: How do ships cut emissions?

segments.src: Caranya antara lain berlayar lebih lambat (*slow steaming*), memodifikasi desain lambung dan baling-baling, serta beralih ke bahan bakar alternatif seperti LNG, metanol, atau amonia.
segments.tr: Methods include sailing more slowly (*slow steaming*), modifying hull and propeller designs, and switching to alternative fuels such as LNG, methanol, or ammonia.

segments.src: **🔁 Kilas balik satu semester**
segments.tr: **🔁 One-semester recap**

segments.src: Agar lengkap, berikut peta besar materi kita:
segments.tr: For completeness, here is the overall map of our material:

segments.src: - **Moda transportasi:** laut (murah, lambat, volume besar), udara (cepat, mahal), darat/rel, dan multimoda.
segments.tr: - **Transport modes:** sea (cheap, slow, high volume), air (fast, expensive), land and rail, and multimodal.

segments.src: - **Kontainerisasi:** kotak standar (TEU/FEU) yang membuat bongkar-muat cepat dan perpindahan antarmoda mudah.
segments.tr: - **Containerization:** standard boxes (TEU/FEU) that make loading and unloading fast and transfers between modes easy.

segments.src: - **Incoterms:** aturan internasional (misalnya FOB, CIF, DAP) yang menentukan di titik mana biaya dan risiko berpindah dari penjual ke pembeli.
segments.tr: - **Incoterms:** international rules (for example FOB, CIF, DAP) that determine the point at which costs and risks pass from seller to buyer.

segments.src: - **Dokumen dan kepabeanan:** Bill of Lading, invoice, packing list, Certificate of Origin, serta prosedur ekspor-impor.
segments.tr: - **Documents and customs:** Bill of Lading, invoice, packing list, Certificate of Origin, and export-import procedures.

segments.src: - **Pelaku:** pengirim (*shipper*), perusahaan pelayaran (*carrier*), *freight forwarder*, pelabuhan, dan bea cukai.
segments.tr: - **Actors:** shipper, carrier, freight forwarder, port, and customs authority.

segments.src: - **Risiko dan asuransi:** kerusakan, keterlambatan, dan gangguan rute.
segments.tr: - **Risk and insurance:** damage, delays, and route disruptions.

segments.src: - **Tren masa depan:** digitalisasi dan dekarbonisasi, materi hari ini.
segments.tr: - **Future trends:** digitalization and decarbonization, today's material.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Ambil contoh Bu Rina, eksportir kopi robusta dari **Lampung** yang mengirim satu kontainer 20 kaki ke **Rotterdam**, Belanda.
segments.tr: Take Ms. Rina, a robusta coffee exporter from **Lampung** who ships one 20-foot container to **Rotterdam**, the Netherlands.

segments.src: - Dokumen kepabeanannya diurus secara elektronik lewat **INSW (Indonesia National Single Window)**, jadi ia tidak perlu bolak-balik membawa berkas ke kantor bea cukai.
segments.tr: - Customs documents are handled electronically through the **INSW (Indonesia National Single Window)**, so Rina does not have to make repeated trips to the customs office with paperwork.

segments.src: - Setelah kontainer dimuat di **Tanjung Priok**, ia bisa memantau posisinya lewat aplikasi pelayaran: kapan transit di Singapura, kapan tiba di Rotterdam.
segments.tr: - After the container is loaded at **Tanjung Priok**, Rina can monitor its position through a shipping app: when it transits Singapore, when it arrives in Rotterdam.

segments.src: - Dalam tagihan ongkos kirim, ia menemukan pos baru: **ETS surcharge**. Ini biaya tambahan dari perusahaan pelayaran untuk menutup kewajiban membeli izin emisi di Eropa. Nilainya memang hanya sebagian kecil dari total ongkos kirim yang mencapai jutaan rupiah per kontainer, tetapi kini masuk hitungan harga jual.
segments.tr: - On the freight invoice, Rina finds a new line item: the **ETS surcharge**. This is an additional fee from the shipping company to cover its obligation to buy emission allowances in Europe. The amount is only a small part of total shipping costs, which reach millions of rupiah per container, but it now counts toward the selling price.

segments.src: - Pembelinya di Eropa juga mulai meminta data jejak karbon pengiriman. Karena itu, Bu Rina mempertimbangkan perusahaan pelayaran yang bisa menyediakan laporan emisi.
segments.tr: - Buyers in Europe are also starting to ask for carbon footprint data on shipments. Because of this, Rina is considering shipping companies that can provide emissions reports.

segments.src: Pelajarannya: isu "hijau" bukan sekadar urusan kapal.
segments.tr: The lesson: "green" is not just a matter for ships.

segments.src: Isu ini sudah masuk ke **harga, kontrak, dan daya saing** eksportir Indonesia.
segments.tr: It has entered the **prices, contracts, and competitiveness** of Indonesian exporters.

segments.src: ## 3 Poin Penting
segments.tr: ## 3 Key Points

segments.src: 1. Logistik digital membuat barang dan dokumen bisa dilacak dan diproses lebih cepat, misalnya lewat IoT, eB/L, dan single window seperti INSW.
segments.tr: 1. Digital logistics lets goods and documents be tracked and processed faster, for example through IoT, eB/L, and single windows such as INSW.

segments.src: 2. IMO menargetkan net-zero emisi pelayaran sekitar 2050, dengan aturan yang sudah berjalan seperti batas sulfur 0,50%, EEXI, dan CII.
segments.tr: 2. The IMO targets net-zero shipping emissions around 2050, with rules already in effect such as the 0.50% sulfur limit, EEXI, and CII.

segments.src: 3. Aturan karbon, termasuk EU ETS, kini terasa langsung dalam biaya pengiriman sehingga ikut menentukan daya saing eksportir.
segments.tr: 3. Carbon rules, including the EU ETS, now show up directly in shipping costs, so they also shape the competitiveness of exporters.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **IMO (International Maritime Organization):** badan PBB yang membuat aturan keselamatan dan lingkungan untuk pelayaran internasional.
segments.tr: - **IMO (International Maritime Organization):** the UN agency that creates safety and environmental rules for international shipping.

segments.src: - **CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator):** peringkat tahunan A–E untuk efisiensi karbon operasional sebuah kapal.
segments.tr: - **CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator):** an annual A–E rating of a ship's operational carbon efficiency.

segments.src: - **EU ETS:** sistem perdagangan izin emisi Uni Eropa yang sejak 2024 juga mencakup pelayaran.
segments.tr: - **EU ETS:** the European Union emissions allowance trading system, which since 2024 also covers shipping.

segments.src: - **eB/L (electronic Bill of Lading):** versi digital dari Bill of Lading, yaitu tanda terima barang sekaligus dokumen kepemilikan muatan.
segments.tr: - **eB/L (electronic Bill of Lading):** the digital version of the Bill of Lading, serving as both a receipt for goods and a document of cargo ownership.

segments.src: - **Single Window:** sistem satu pintu elektronik untuk mengurus perizinan dan kepabeanan perdagangan, di Indonesia disebut INSW.
segments.tr: - **Single Window:** an electronic one-stop system for trade licensing and customs procedures, called INSW in Indonesia.

segments.tr: *Answers: 1-b (CII measures annual operational carbon intensity, not the ship's design or capacity).

segments.tr: 2-T (the IMO 2020 rule lowered the sulfur limit from 3.50% to 0.50%; in certain emission control areas the limit is even 0.10%).

id-20261107-news-2.title: COP31 in Antalya Starts Next Week: What's at Stake for Indonesia Regarding Energy Transition and Climate Finance

segments.src: Konferensi Perubahan Iklim PBB ke-31 (COP31) dijadwalkan berlangsung di Antalya, Turki, pada pertengahan November 2026.
segments.tr: The 31st UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) is scheduled to take place in Antalya, Turkey, in mid-November 2026.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, pertemuan ini penting karena membahas dua hal yang saling terkait: seberapa cepat emisi dikurangi, dan siapa yang menanggung biaya transisinya.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, this meeting is important because it discusses two interrelated issues: how quickly emissions are reduced, and who bears the cost of the transition.

segments.src: Tulisan ini merangkum agenda utama dan kaitannya dengan kepentingan Indonesia.
segments.tr: This article summarizes the main agenda and its connection to Indonesia's interests.

segments.src: Jadwal dan agenda rinci bisa berubah, jadi pembaca sebaiknya merujuk pada situs resmi UNFCCC untuk informasi terbaru.
segments.tr: The schedule and detailed agenda may change, so readers should refer to the official UNFCCC website for the latest information.

segments.src: ## Gambaran singkat COP31
segments.tr: ## A brief overview of COP31

segments.src: COP adalah pertemuan tahunan para pihak dalam Konvensi Kerangka Kerja PBB tentang Perubahan Iklim (UNFCCC).
segments.tr: COP is the annual meeting of the parties to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).

segments.src: Di forum ini, hampir seluruh negara di dunia merundingkan cara melaksanakan Perjanjian Paris, yang menargetkan pembatasan kenaikan suhu global jauh di bawah 2°C dan mengupayakan 1,5°C dibandingkan masa praindustri.
segments.tr: In this forum, almost all countries in the world negotiate how to implement the Paris Agreement, which targets limiting the global temperature rise to well below 2°C and pursuing 1.5°C compared to pre-industrial times.

segments.src: Setiap COP biasanya menghasilkan keputusan tentang target pengurangan emisi, pendanaan, adaptasi, dan aturan pelaporan.
segments.tr: Each COP usually produces decisions on emission reduction targets, funding, adaptation, and reporting rules.

segments.src: Hasilnya berupa kesepakatan politik yang perlu diterjemahkan ke kebijakan nasional, sehingga dampaknya baru terlihat bertahun-tahun kemudian.
segments.tr: The results are political agreements that need to be translated into national policies, so the impact is only seen years later.

segments.src: ## Agenda utama yang akan disorot
segments.tr: ## Main agenda to be highlighted

segments.src: ### 1. Pendanaan iklim
segments.tr: ### 1. Climate finance

segments.src: Pendanaan menjadi isu yang paling sulit dalam perundingan iklim.
segments.tr: Funding is the most difficult issue in climate negotiations.

segments.src: Pada COP29 di Baku, negara-negara menyepakati target pendanaan iklim baru, yang sering disebut New Collective Quantified Goal (NCQG).
segments.tr: At COP29 in Baku, countries agreed on a new climate finance target, often referred to as the New Collective Quantified Goal (NCQG).

segments.src: Targetnya setidaknya 300 miliar dolar AS per tahun pada 2035 dari negara maju untuk negara berkembang, dengan ajakan untuk mengupayakan total 1,3 triliun dolar AS per tahun dari berbagai sumber.
segments.tr: The target is at least 300 billion US dollars per year by 2035 from developed countries for developing countries, with a call to strive for a total of 1.3 trillion US dollars per year from various sources.

segments.src: Pertanyaan yang kemungkinan muncul lagi di Antalya:
segments.tr: Questions that are likely to arise again in Antalya:

segments.src: - Seberapa besar bagian pendanaan yang berupa hibah dan pinjaman lunak, dibandingkan pinjaman komersial?
segments.tr: - How much of the funding will be in the form of grants and concessional loans, compared to commercial loans?

segments.src: - Bagaimana mekanisme pelacakan dan pelaporan agar angka yang dijanjikan benar-benar terealisasi?
segments.tr: - What are the tracking and reporting mechanisms to ensure the promised figures are actually realized?

segments.src: - Bagaimana pendanaan adaptasi ditingkatkan, mengingat kebutuhan negara berkembang untuk menghadapi banjir, kekeringan, dan kenaikan permukaan laut terus bertambah?
segments.tr: - How can adaptation funding be increased, given that the needs of developing countries to deal with floods, droughts, and rising sea levels continue to grow?

segments.src: ### 2. Pengurangan emisi dan target nasional
segments.tr: ### 2. Emission reduction and national targets

segments.src: Setiap negara menyampaikan target pengurangan emisi melalui Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC).
segments.tr: Each country submits emission reduction targets through its Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC).

segments.src: Pembaruan NDC generasi terbaru mencakup target hingga 2035.
segments.tr: The latest generation of NDC updates includes targets up to 2035.

segments.src: Di COP31, para pihak diperkirakan menilai apakah target yang terkumpul sudah cukup untuk menjaga jalur suhu yang disepakati.
segments.tr: At COP31, parties are expected to assess whether the collected targets are sufficient to maintain the agreed temperature pathway.

segments.src: Banyak kajian ilmiah menyebut masih ada selisih antara janji negara dan tingkat pengurangan emisi yang dibutuhkan.
segments.tr: Many scientific studies state that there is still a gap between countries' promises and the level of emission reduction needed.

segments.src: ### 3. Transisi energi
segments.tr: ### 3. Energy transition

segments.src: Pembahasan tentang peralihan dari bahan bakar fosil, dan ajakan menaikkan kapasitas energi terbarukan serta efisiensi energi secara global, juga menjadi bagian penting.
segments.tr: Discussions on the shift away from fossil fuels, and calls to increase renewable energy capacity and energy efficiency globally, are also an important part.

segments.src: Perundingan di forum ini biasanya berjalan alot karena kepentingan ekonomi tiap negara berbeda, terutama antara produsen dan konsumen energi fosil.
segments.tr: Negotiations in this forum are usually tough because each country's economic interests differ, especially between fossil fuel producers and consumers.

segments.src: ## Mengapa ini penting bagi Indonesia
segments.tr: ## Why this is important for Indonesia

segments.src: ### Ketergantungan pada batu bara
segments.tr: ### Dependence on coal

segments.src: Indonesia termasuk produsen dan pengguna batu bara yang besar.
segments.tr: Indonesia is a major producer and user of coal.

segments.src: Sebagian besar listrik nasional masih dihasilkan oleh pembangkit listrik tenaga uap (PLTU) batu bara, dan banyak di antaranya relatif muda sehingga masih punya masa operasi panjang.
segments.tr: Most of the national electricity is still generated by coal-fired power plants (PLTU), and many of them are relatively young, so they still have a long operational life.

segments.src: Karena itu, sektor ketenagalistrikan menjadi salah satu penyumbang emisi terbesar dan sekaligus bidang yang paling menentukan arah transisi.
segments.tr: Therefore, the electricity sector is one of the largest contributors to emissions and at the same time the area that most determines the direction of the transition.

segments.src: ### Pensiun dini PLTU
segments.tr: ### Early retirement of coal power plants

segments.src: Gagasan pensiun dini PLTU bertujuan menghentikan operasi pembangkit batu bara sebelum masa ekonomisnya berakhir, lalu menggantinya dengan sumber yang lebih bersih.
segments.tr: The idea of early retirement of coal power plants aims to stop the operation of coal plants before their economic life ends, then replace them with cleaner sources.

segments.src: Tantangannya ada pada beberapa hal:
segments.tr: The challenges lie in several things:

segments.src: - **Biaya:** pemilik pembangkit perlu kompensasi karena kehilangan pendapatan yang sudah direncanakan, sehingga dibutuhkan pembiayaan yang besar.
segments.tr: - **Costs:** plant owners need compensation for lost revenue that had been planned, so large financing is needed.

segments.src: - **Keandalan pasokan:** pengganti PLTU harus mampu menjaga pasokan listrik tetap stabil, termasuk lewat jaringan transmisi dan penyimpanan energi.
segments.tr: - **Supply reliability:** replacements for coal plants must be able to keep electricity supply stable, including through transmission networks and energy storage.

segments.src: - **Dampak sosial:** pekerja, pemasok, dan pemerintah daerah di wilayah penghasil batu bara perlu perlindungan dan alternatif ekonomi, yang sering disebut transisi berkeadilan.
segments.tr: - **Social impact:** workers, suppliers, and local governments in coal-producing regions need protection and economic alternatives, which is often called a just transition.

segments.src: Kemitraan transisi energi yang melibatkan Indonesia dan sejumlah negara mitra, seperti Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP), mengumumkan komitmen pendanaan awal sekitar 20 miliar dolar AS pada 2022.
segments.tr: Energy transition partnerships involving Indonesia and a number of partner countries, such as the Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP), announced an initial funding commitment of around 20 billion US dollars in 2022.

segments.src: Pelaksanaannya menghadapi tantangan, antara lain perubahan komposisi mitra, proses penyiapan proyek, dan skema pembiayaan.
segments.tr: Implementation faces challenges, including changes in the composition of partners, the project preparation process, and financing schemes.

segments.src: Karena itu, hasil perundingan pendanaan di COP31 dapat memengaruhi kemudahan proyek semacam ini di lapangan.
segments.tr: Therefore, the results of the funding negotiations at COP31 could affect the ease of such projects on the ground.

segments.src: ### Energi terbarukan
segments.tr: ### Renewable energy

segments.src: Indonesia memiliki potensi besar di tenaga surya, panas bumi, air, dan angin.
segments.tr: Indonesia has great potential in solar, geothermal, hydro, and wind power.

segments.src: Namun realisasi bauran energi terbarukan masih tertinggal dari target.
segments.tr: However, the realization of the renewable energy mix is still lagging behind the target.

segments.src: Hambatan yang sering disebut meliputi perizinan, kepastian harga pembelian listrik, akses pembiayaan, dan kesiapan jaringan.
segments.tr: Obstacles often cited include permitting, certainty of electricity purchase prices, access to financing, and grid readiness.

segments.src: Kejelasan arah pendanaan global dapat membantu menurunkan biaya modal untuk proyek-proyek tersebut.
segments.tr: Clarity on the direction of global funding can help lower the cost of capital for these projects.

segments.src: ### Komitmen dan posisi Indonesia
segments.tr: ### Indonesia's commitment and position

segments.src: Indonesia memiliki target pengurangan emisi dalam NDC dan menyatakan tujuan mencapai emisi nol bersih.
segments.tr: Indonesia has emission reduction targets in its NDC and has stated its goal of achieving net-zero emissions.

segments.src: Pemerintah juga pernah menyampaikan rencana mengakhiri penggunaan PLTU batu bara dalam jangka waktu tertentu, dengan penekanan bahwa dukungan pendanaan dan teknologi dari mitra internasional menjadi syarat penting.
segments.tr: The government has also previously announced plans to end the use of coal-fired power plants within a certain period, with the emphasis that funding and technology support from international partners is an important condition.

segments.src: Di forum COP, posisi Indonesia umumnya menekankan prinsip tanggung jawab bersama yang dibedakan, serta kebutuhan akan pendanaan yang dapat diakses dan terjangkau.
segments.tr: In the COP forum, Indonesia's position generally emphasizes the principle of common but differentiated responsibilities, as well as the need for accessible and affordable funding.

segments.src: Hutan dan lahan gambut juga menjadi bagian dari agenda Indonesia, termasuk perdagangan karbon dan pengelolaan hutan sebagai penyerap emisi.
segments.tr: Forests and peatlands are also part of Indonesia's agenda, including carbon trading and forest management as emission sinks.

segments.src: Aturan pasar karbon di bawah Perjanjian Paris dapat memengaruhi peluang dan standar yang berlaku bagi proyek di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: Carbon market rules under the Paris Agreement can affect the opportunities and standards that apply to projects in the country.

segments.src: ## Apa yang perlu dicermati
segments.tr: ## What to watch

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang layak diikuti selama konferensi:
segments.tr: Some things worth following during the conference:

segments.src: 1. **Kejelasan angka pendanaan:** apakah ada rincian bagaimana target pendanaan akan dicapai, termasuk porsi hibah dan pinjaman.
segments.tr: 1. **Clarity of funding figures:** whether there are details on how the funding target will be achieved, including the portion of grants and loans.

segments.src: 2. **Bahasa soal bahan bakar fosil:** seberapa tegas teks keputusan mengenai transisi dari energi fosil dan perannya bagi negara berkembang.
segments.tr: 2. **Language on fossil fuels:** how firm the decision text is regarding the transition from fossil energy and its role for developing countries.

segments.src: 3. **Dukungan untuk transisi berkeadilan:** apakah ada mekanisme yang konkret untuk pekerja dan wilayah yang terdampak.
segments.tr: 3. **Support for a just transition:** whether there are concrete mechanisms for workers and affected regions.

segments.src: 4. **Aturan pasar karbon dan pelaporan:** bagaimana standar transparansi dan integritas kredit karbon diperjelas.
segments.tr: 4. **Carbon market and reporting rules:** how transparency and integrity standards for carbon credits are clarified.

segments.src: 5. **Pendanaan adaptasi:** apakah ada peningkatan yang berarti bagi negara yang rentan terhadap bencana iklim.
segments.tr: 5. **Adaptation funding:** whether there is a significant increase for countries vulnerable to climate disasters.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: COP31 di Antalya tidak akan menyelesaikan semua persoalan iklim dalam satu pertemuan.
segments.tr: COP31 in Antalya will not solve all climate problems in one meeting.

segments.src: Meski begitu, keputusan di sana dapat memengaruhi arah pendanaan dan kebijakan energi dalam beberapa tahun ke depan.
segments.tr: Even so, decisions there can influence the direction of funding and energy policy in the coming years.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, tantangannya adalah menyeimbangkan kebutuhan listrik yang terus tumbuh, pengurangan emisi, dan perlindungan bagi masyarakat yang terdampak peralihan energi.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, the challenge is to balance the continuously growing need for electricity, emission reduction, and protection for communities affected by the energy transition.

segments.src: Masyarakat dapat mengikuti perkembangan dari sumber resmi, seperti situs UNFCCC dan pernyataan pemerintah, serta membandingkannya dengan laporan media tepercaya.
segments.tr: The public can follow developments from official sources, such as the UNFCCC website and government statements, and compare them with reports from trusted media.
